label: Demo data and sample business rules
demo_notice: DEMO ONLY: every service, boundary, threshold, script and deadline below is an invented sample for the MVP. None of it is Aangan Studio's actual commercial policy. Replace before any live pilot.

services.name: Structural construction (demo: excluded)
services.decline_script: Our sample service list covers interior design for homes and small offices. Structural construction is outside that list, so I can't arrange it, but I'll note your enquiry for the team.

service_area.label: Pune (demo boundary)
service_area.outside_area_script: Thank you. Our sample service area for this demo is Pune, so the studio may not be able to take this on, but I'll note your details for the team.

fields.question: What kind of project are you planning: a full home interior, an office interior, or something else?
fields.why_needed: Determines whether the enquiry is a service the studio offers and which designer specialism fits.

fields.question: Which city and area is the property in?
fields.why_needed: Checks the enquiry against the studio's service area before a designer travels.

fields.question: Roughly how large is the space, and is that carpet area or built-up area?
fields.why_needed: Gives the designer the scope. The basis matters because carpet and built-up areas differ.
fields.confirm_prompt: Just to confirm, that is about {area_sqft} square feet, {area_basis}?

fields.question: When are you hoping to start the work?
fields.why_needed: Tells the team how soon to schedule and whether the project is active.

fields.question: Do you have a budget in mind for the project? It's fine if you'd rather not say.
fields.why_needed: Helps the designer prepare suitable options. The caller may decline; a missing budget sends the enquiry for review, not rejection.
fields.confirm_prompt: Could you tell me that budget figure again, including whether it is in lakh or crore?

fields.question: May I have your name, please?
fields.why_needed: So the designer can address the caller and match the record.

fields.question: When is a good time for someone from the studio to call you back?
fields.why_needed: Avoids missed callbacks and repeat calls.

fields.question: If you'd like a calendar invitation, which email address should we use?
fields.why_needed: Only needed when the calendar booking requires an email address.
fields.confirm_prompt: Let me read that back: {contact_email}. Is that right?

qualification_rules.description: Only new project enquiries are qualified automatically; other intents go to the front desk.
Demo: full-home and small-office interiors are supported; structural construction is not.
Demo: the property must be in the Pune sample boundary.
The caller must confirm a positive area read-back.
Demo threshold (invented, not derived from the case): stated budget of at least 8 lakh rupees (80,000,000 paise).
Demo: start expected within six months. Later starts go to review rather than rejection.

pricing_request.say: A designer will confirm pricing after reviewing your scope. I can capture your details and help book a consultation.

complaint.say: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll pass this to the team so a person can follow up with you directly.

commitment_request.say: I'm not able to make commitments about costs, dates or terms. A designer will discuss that with you after reviewing your scope.

human_requested.say: Of course. I'll ask the front desk to take over.
human_requested.say_after_hours: The front desk is closed right now. I'll arrange for someone to call you back during working hours.

urgent.say: I understand this is urgent. I'll flag it for the team to follow up as a priority.

scripts.disclosure: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm an automated assistant, and this call may be transcribed so the team can follow up. You can ask for a person at any time.
scripts.language_prompt: Would you prefer to continue in English, Hindi or Marathi?
scripts.qualified_close: Thank you. Your project sounds like the kind our designers take on.
scripts.needs_review_close: Thank you. A member of the team will review your details and call you back.
scripts.not_fit_close: Thank you for calling. I've noted your enquiry for the team.
scripts.booking_offer: Would you like to book a consultation with a designer?
scripts.booking_read_back: To confirm, you'd like a consultation on {slot_label}. Shall I book it?
scripts.booking_conflict: That time has just been taken. Could you choose another time?
scripts.booking_pending: I couldn't confirm that booking just now, so it is not booked yet. The team will call you to arrange a time.
scripts.booking_declined: No problem. A designer will call you to follow up.
scripts.handoff_confirmation: I've passed your details to the team so you won't need to repeat them.
scripts.policy_missing_fallback: Thank you for calling Aangan Studio. I'll take your details and the team will call you back.
scripts.recording_declined: Understood. I won't keep a transcript. I'll take a short message so the team can call you back.
